newsitem.title: HONG KONG: GZI Transport to issue 250 mln shrs at HK$3.23/shr.
newsitem.headline: GZI Transport to issue 250 mln shrs at HK$3.23/shr.

text.p: Guangzhou Investment Co Ltd's infrastructural spinoff, GZI Transport Ltd, said on Monday it plans to issue 250 million shares at HK$3.23 per share.
GZI Transport said 187.5 million shares would be placed internationally, with the remaining 62.5 million shares offered in Hong Kong in an initial public offering.
Warrants would be attached in the proportion of one warrent for every five shares subscribed.

In the public offer, 31.25 million shares will be available for public subscription, a maximum of 25 million shares will be offered preferentially to existing shareholders of Guangzhou Investment and a maximum of 6.25 million shares will be available for employee subscription, the company said.
GZI Transport said it has granted lead manager and global coordinator Peregrine Capital an over-allotment option to request the company to issue up to 37.5 million additional shares.
The IPO will run from January 21-24, with dealing in the shares expected to begin on January 30.

Proceeds of the share issue would be used to finance investment in existing and future toll road projects in China, GZI Transport. It now has six toll road projects, mainly in China's southern Guangdong province.
The company forecast annual net profit for the year ending December 31, 1997, of not less than HK$143 million, the document said.
